title: Explanation of Binary Arithmetic
author: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz
description: Introduction of the binary number system using only 0 and 1, with remarks on its utility
rights: Public domain. Leibniz's 1703 French, in Gerhardt's 1863 edition (original/), translated by Enchiridion in 2026 and released with the repository under MIT. Two independent passes, adjudicated; see translation-notes.md. The interlinear shows the French witness beside the English. Lloyd Strickland's copyrighted 2007 translation, which this directory once held as its source, was untracked on 2026-09-13 and is not published; it remains in the git history until the source-file question in RIGHTS_AUDIT.md is settled.
